newsitem.title: THAILAND: THAI BAHT, INTERBANK RATES STEADY IN LATE TRADE.
newsitem.headline: THAI BAHT, INTERBANK RATES STEADY IN LATE TRADE.

text.p: The Thai baht stood steady against the dollar in late cautious trade on Thursday as the market turned attention to the turmoil faced by the Indonesian rupiah, dealers said.
"It's very narrow range trade today. I think most people watched the development in (Indonesian) rupiah," said one dealer at a local bank.
The Indonesian central bank on Thursday floated the rupiah, triggering its steep fall against the dollar.
The baht stood at 31.50/31.60 in late trade in the domestic market compared with 31.53/31.63 in the early morning.
Dealers said the rupiah's loss produced some psychological impact on the baht, reducing market interest to take short dollar positions.
"Rupiah's impact on the baht was very little today. I think its turmoil is the latest victim of the baht float," said another dealer.
The baht was quoted at 31.35/31.55 late offshore against 31.35/31.45 earlier.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium was quoted at 14/16 satangs per dollar late in the domestic market and 26/36 satangs offshore.
The overnight interbank rate was steady at 12.00 percent compared with 11.00-12.00 percent in the early morning.
